newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Avonmore unit's securities BBB-.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Avonmore unit's securities BBB-.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it had assigned its BBB minus rating to the $100 million 7.99 percent cumulative, guaranteed preferred securities, Series A, due November 14, 2006, issued by Avonmore Delaware.
"The issue is guaranteed by Avonmore Foods Plc, an Irish based food processing company, which has a corporate credit rating of BBB," S&P said in a statement.
S&P also said the outlook for the rating was positive.

"An upgrade may be achievable for Avonmore over the next two to three years, assuming the continuation of the company's positive overall earnings trend and maintenance of stable debt and interest coverage ratios," it said.

"In the half year ended June 29, 1996, earnings growth and diversity provided by its operations in dairy and agricultural inputs helped offset declining profits in Avonmore's meat sector, resulting in overall flat operating profits for this period."

It added that the relatively modest level of Avonmore's cash flows and scale of its operations, combined with a relatively short operating track record in some markets, limited the potential for a higher rating at this time.
